biotools.summary: ConDiGA is a pipeline for accurate taxonomic annotation of genes from metagenomic data, optimizing the construction of protein sequence databases for metaproteomic analysis. It uses a 'contigs directed' approach and has demonstrated improved performance compared to other methods.
